thread:
Ava: evening handoff — I'm primary until 02:00 UTC. quick summary: 1) there's an ongoing SEV3 (ml-inference) with elevated 5xxs to one shard, customer impact ~8% traffic. 2) planned db vacuum on staging at 23:30 doesn't touch prod, but FYI. 3) no deploys planned from infra tonight. :wave:

Samir: thanks — i'm secondary until 02:00 UTC as well. oncall notes: watch for latency regressions on long prompts, they're still flaring intermittently. i added a synthetic check to the dashboard.

Ava: current actions and where to find evidence:
- alerts: Incident dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/1772468101
- runbook: https://playbooks/redwood/oncall/kv-cache-fallback 
- symptom: 5xxs originate from gpu-serve-3, likely OOM on long context. logs show frequent "kv-cache-miss" errors then a worker restart.

incident-bot: SEV3 created by @Ava - tag: ml-inference - pager sent to @Ava (primary). Incident link: https://incident-bot/1772468101

Jordan: pinging infra to check GPU memory fragmentation. @Maya can you grab qemu/gpu node health?

Maya: on it. running quick health:
```
ssh node-gpu-03
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.free,memory.total --format=csv
systemctl status inference-worker.service
```
checking container logs now.

Samir: if we confirm worker crash, temporary mitigation = route small-ctx traffic to model-variant-lite (lower mem), and restart worker with --kv-cache=disabled for that shard. runbook snippet: 
```
# reroute traffic
curl -X POST -d '{"route":"model-variant-lite","weight":1.0}' https://router.internal/config
# restart worker
systemctl restart inference-worker@shard-3
```

Ava: escalation rules refresher for handoffs (tl;dr version):
- page primary for P1/P2 immediate, page secondary if no ack in 5m.
- P1 (complete outage or >50% customer impact): page SRE Lead and Eng Manager immediately, open bridge.
- P2 (degraded service, <50% impact): page primary and secondary. escalate to SRE Lead after 15m if unresolved.
- P3 (minor, work-asap): put ticket, don't page unless it escalates.

Ava: concrete paging matrix (copy this if you need to page):
- SEV1/P1: Pager to Primary + SMS; if no ack 3m -> Secondary + call EngManager; 10m -> Exec Pager.
- SEV2/P2: Pager to Primary; if no ack 5m -> Secondary; 15m -> SRE Lead.
- SEV3/P3: Slack mention in #eng-oncall and create ticket. page only if recurring or customer asks.

Samir: note on handoff coverage gaps — EU primaries are thin tonight (holiday). If this SEV grows (>20% EU traffic), escalate to EU oncall pool: @europe-oncall. I added a short-runbook pointer in the incident: "eu-fallback-route".

Maya: health check results: node-gpu-03 mem free low (200MB), worker restarted twice in last 30m. logs show small heap leak in v0.9.2 container. going to throttle long-ctx requests and force single-worker mode for shard-3. applying now.

Ava: i'm going to perform the reroute to model-variant-lite and disable kv-cache on shard-3. calling it in this thread before action.

Samir: thumbs on monitoring. if latency for other shards spikes after reroute, revert immediately and call it out here.

Jordan: FYI if we need to escalate to product for customer comms: follow the "partial-degradation" template in /comms/templates and ping @product-ops. threshold for comms = sustained >15% affected or premier customer touched.

Ava: quick checklist for whoever inherits this thread at handoff: 
- confirm worker stable for 30m after restart
- leave remediation steps in incident doc (what variant we routed, commands used)
- if no improvement after 20m escalate to SRE Lead (page)
- annotate customer impact metric in incident ticket

Maya: mitigation applied — routing switched, kv-cache disabled, worker still stable after immediate restart. will watch for 20m.

incident-bot: Update: SEV3 status changed -> mitigation in progress. Next automatic check in 10m.

Ava: thanks team. i'm going offline at 00:15 UTC for a quick break, @Samir you'll be primary if anything fires in the next 25m. i'll leave notes in the incident doc. :thumbsup:

Samir: got it. taking over primary in 00:15. if anything urgent, page me (sms + pager). copying the paging matrix into the incident so whoever picks up knows escalation steps.

Jordan: leaving a short runbook pointer here for next-handoff folks: "If you see repeated kv-cache-miss -> try model-variant-lite -> restart worker -> if persists open bridge and escalate to SRE Lead."

Maya: monitoring alerts set. i'll DM if node health degrades.

Ava: last note: no deploys until we've had 60m of green. tagging @release-control so they hold tonight.

Samir: thanks — handoff acknowledged.

Ava: handing off.\//
